policy.description: Keep the complete package source, but narrow routine integration work to active components. Frozen and archive-only components are verified by baseline tree hash and are not routinely reread or retested unless explicitly thawed or a boundary dependency changes.
routine_start: Read this manifest before broad development handovers.
Map changed files with development/scope.py map.
Work only in active components plus any boundary-active component crossed by the change.
Do not inspect or run dedicated tests for frozen/archive-only components when their baseline hashes are unchanged.
Run the full deterministic/package/release gates only at a release milestone or when explicitly requested.

status_meaning.active: Routine current development surface; inspect and run focused tests when relevant.
status_meaning.boundary_active: Normally stable interface layer; inspect/test only when an active change crosses its boundary or the component itself changes.
status_meaning.frozen: Retained unchanged in package; verify tree hash only during routine work. Thaw before intentional edits.
status_meaning.archive_only: Historical evidence/source retained for provenance; do not load during routine current-state reasoning.

full_release_gate.note: Frozen status reduces routine iteration only. Before final release acceptance, run the complete deterministic/source/package gates and any device gates required by the current release handover.

installer-convergence.description: Install/upgrade lifecycle, Open WebUI migration/convergence/publication, administrator/API-key bootstrap and Ollama setup.
notes: Open WebUI publication remains fail-closed until authenticated desired-state convergence succeeds.
The protected maintenance credential is a real Open WebUI sk-* API key, not a signin JWT.

openwebui-product.description: Curated roles, Advanced/Deep/translation behavior, desired state, functions, prompts and Open WebUI product contracts.
notes: Advanced current candidate is think=true with max_tokens=6144 and unchanged samplers.
Deep pre-evicts task/embedding and uses exact keep_alive=2m.
Translation integrity is ordered, clause-local and polarity-aware.

benchmark-revalidation.description: Benchmarking, quality classification, resource evidence and whole-appliance revalidation.
notes: Clean reasoning-only exhaustion at the production ceiling is INCOMPLETE; repetitive degeneration remains a quality defect.

model-catalog-current.description: Current production/experiment/task/embedding/agent model registry, model profiles and model lifecycle controller. Retired/graveyard content is separate archive-only scope.
notes: Qwen3.6 35B remains retired from active qualification.
Catalog work may mention frozen MTP/RAG/OCR surfaces but must not thaw them unless their implementation boundary changes.

runtime-cu-memory.description: Live CU routing/status, memory/swap profile, Ollama lane topology, governor and runtime state.
boundary_interfaces: configured BC250_WGP_MASKS versus live SPI layout
memory hard floor and swap/zram policy
notes: CU routing uses bc250-cu-live-manager on the stock AMDGPU path; the replacement-module backend is retired.

verification-diagnostics.description: Verifier, status, diagnostics, support bundles and LAN verification.

packaging-source.description: RPM metadata, install manifest, upstream/source preparation and source validators.

global-docs-coordination.description: Current operator docs, validation strategy and current integration handovers. Historical evidence remains archive-only.
boundary_interfaces: current instructions must override historical evidence
notes: WORKBENCH-STATE.json is checkpoint-only continuity metadata and is intentionally absent from clean release/source-package payloads.

maintenance-companion.description: Local maintenance timers, backups/restores, safe power and WOL/companion integration; frozen after canonical bc250 dispatcher migration.
thaw_if: protected Open WebUI credential path/format changes
Open WebUI database or backup path changes
service/unit names used by maintenance change
backup/restore ownership or shutdown policy changes

rag-tika.description: Product RAG/Documents lifecycle, ingestion, embedding lane, Tika extraction, examples and dedicated RAG qualification.
thaw_if: embedding model or port 11437 contract changes
Open WebUI Documents/RAG desired-state keys change

mtp.description: Standalone llama.cpp MTP models and comparison helpers; frozen after canonical bc250 dispatcher migration.
thaw_if: MTP is explicitly returned to active comparison
generic model lifecycle begins managing MTP

coding-agent.description: Coding/Gitea agent workflow helpers; frozen after canonical bc250 dispatcher migration.
thaw_if: coding/Gitea agent workflow is explicitly resumed

ocr.description: Dedicated OCR helper workflow; frozen after canonical bc250 dispatcher migration.
thaw_if: OCR workflow becomes a current device/product requirement

uninstall.description: Package reset/uninstall behavior; thawed for 0.12.2-0.6 because the retired replacement-module ownership and cleanup surface was removed.

historical-development.description: Historical model runs, references, patch notes and superseded release handovers retained for provenance only.

quality-history.description: Historical quality-check result snapshots retained for evidence provenance, not current routine reasoning.

graveyard-models.description: Retired Modelfiles retained for provenance, including the closed EuroLLM challenger; active retirement state is owned by models/retired-models.json.

gfx1013-experimental.description: Opt-in exact-kernel GFX1013 compute-queue lifecycle, pinned source/patch identity, private Ollama-only RADV and fail-closed rollback.
notes: Default OFF. Stock saved/default boot must remain authoritative until a verified patched boot is explicitly enabled.
Final erase/reset must restore and verify stock saved + next boot before destructive GFX1013 cleanup.
